questions.q_en: She ___ to school by bus every day.
questions.q_bn: সে প্রতিদিন বাসে স্কুলে ___।
questions.explain_en: 'Every day' shows a habitual action, so the simple present tense is used. With the third-person singular subject 'she', the verb takes -s: goes.
questions.explain_bn: 'Every day' অভ্যাসগত কাজ বোঝায়, তাই simple present tense ব্যবহৃত হয়। Third-person singular subject 'she'-এর সাথে verb-এর শেষে -s যোগ হয়: goes।

questions.q_en: By the time we reached the station, the train ___.
questions.q_bn: আমরা স্টেশনে পৌঁছানোর আগেই ট্রেনটি ___।
questions.explain_en: When two past actions are mentioned, the earlier one uses the past perfect tense (had + past participle).
questions.explain_bn: অতীতের দুটি কাজের মধ্যে আগেরটি past perfect tense-এ (had + past participle) হয়।

questions.q_en: I ___ in Dhaka since 2015.
questions.explain_en: 'Since 2015' shows an action that started in the past and continues in the present, so the present perfect tense is used.
questions.explain_bn: 'Since 2015' এমন কাজ বোঝায় যা অতীতে শুরু হয়ে বর্তমানে চলছে, তাই present perfect tense ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: They ___ the project by next March.
questions.q_bn: তারা আগামী মার্চের মধ্যে প্রকল্পটি ___।
questions.explain_en: 'By next March' is a future deadline, so the future perfect tense (will have + past participle) is used.
questions.explain_bn: 'By next March' ভবিষ্যতের একটি সময়সীমা বোঝায়, তাই future perfect tense (will have + past participle) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: Look at those dark clouds! It ___.
questions.q_bn: ওই কালো মেঘগুলোর দিকে তাকাও! ___।
questions.explain_en: A future event predicted from present evidence (dark clouds) uses 'be going to'.
questions.explain_bn: বর্তমান লক্ষণ (কালো মেঘ) দেখে ভবিষ্যৎ অনুমান করতে 'be going to' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: She ___ dinner when the phone rang.
questions.q_bn: ফোন বাজার সময় সে রাতের খাবার ___।
questions.explain_en: A longer action in progress when another past action interrupted it uses the past continuous tense (was/were + -ing).
questions.explain_bn: অতীতের একটি কাজ চলাকালীন আরেকটি কাজ ঘটলে চলমান কাজটি past continuous tense-এ (was/were + -ing) হয়।

questions.q_en: He ___ here for five years and still works here.
questions.q_bn: সে পাঁচ বছর ধরে এখানে ___ এবং এখনো এখানে কাজ করে।
questions.explain_en: 'For five years' with the action still continuing needs the present perfect continuous tense (has/have been + -ing).
questions.explain_bn: 'For five years' এবং কাজটি এখনো চলমান থাকায় present perfect continuous tense (has/have been + -ing) ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: If he had studied harder, he ___ the test.
questions.q_bn: সে যদি আরও কঠোর পড়াশোনা করত, তবে সে পরীক্ষায় ___।
questions.explain_en: This is a third conditional: if + past perfect is followed by would have + past participle.
questions.explain_bn: এটি third conditional: if + past perfect-এর পরে would have + past participle বসে।

questions.q_en: Choose the passive form: 'The hunter killed the tiger.'
questions.q_bn: 'The hunter killed the tiger.' — বাক্যটির passive form কোনটি?
options_en: The tiger was killed by the hunter.
The tiger is killed by the hunter.
The hunter was killed by the tiger.
The tiger had killed the hunter.
options_bn: The tiger was killed by the hunter.
The tiger is killed by the hunter.
The hunter was killed by the tiger.
The tiger had killed the hunter.
questions.explain_en: Past simple active becomes past simple passive: was/were + past participle, with the object becoming the subject.
questions.explain_bn: Past simple active-এর passive হয় past simple passive: was/were + past participle; object টি subject হয়।

questions.q_en: Choose the passive form: 'They elected him chairman.'
questions.q_bn: 'They elected him chairman.' — বাক্যটির passive form কোনটি?
options_en: He is elected chairman by them.
options_bn: He is elected chairman by them.
questions.explain_en: The object 'him' becomes the subject 'he', and the past simple verb becomes 'was elected'.
questions.explain_bn: Object 'him' subject 'he' হয় এবং past simple verb-টি 'was elected' হয়।

questions.q_en: Choose the passive form: 'Who wrote this poem?'
questions.q_bn: 'Who wrote this poem?' — বাক্যটির passive form কোনটি?
options_en: Who was written this poem by?
This poem was written by who?
By whom was this poem written?
options_bn: Who was written this poem by?
This poem was written by who?
By whom was this poem written?
questions.explain_en: A question beginning with 'who' becomes passive with 'By whom' followed by was/were + past participle.
questions.explain_bn: 'Who' দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্নের passive 'By whom' দিয়ে শুরু হয়, এরপর was/were + past participle বসে।

questions.q_en: Choose the passive form: 'Open the window.'
questions.q_bn: 'Open the window.' — বাক্যটির passive form কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: An imperative sentence becomes passive with 'Let + object + be + past participle'.
questions.explain_bn: Imperative বাক্যের passive হয় 'Let + object + be + past participle' গঠনে।

questions.q_en: Choose the passive form: 'She sings a sweet song.'
questions.q_bn: 'She sings a sweet song.' — বাক্যটির passive form কোনটি?
options_en: A sweet song was sung by her.
A sweet song is sung by her.
A sweet song has sung by her.
She is sung a sweet song.
options_bn: A sweet song was sung by her.
A sweet song is sung by her.
A sweet song has sung by her.
She is sung a sweet song.
questions.explain_en: Present simple active becomes present simple passive: is/am/are + past participle.
questions.explain_bn: Present simple active-এর passive হয় present simple passive: is/am/are + past participle।

questions.q_en: Choose the passive form: 'Do it now.'
questions.q_bn: 'Do it now.' — বাক্যটির passive form কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: An imperative becomes passive with 'Let + object + be + past participle'.
questions.explain_bn: Imperative বাক্যের passive হয় 'Let + object + be + past participle' গঠনে।

questions.q_en: Choose the passive form: 'The news surprised everyone.'
questions.q_bn: 'The news surprised everyone.' — বাক্যটির passive form কোনটি?
options_en: Everyone is surprised by the news.
Everyone was surprised by the news.
The news was surprised by everyone.
options_bn: Everyone is surprised by the news.
Everyone was surprised by the news.
The news was surprised by everyone.
questions.explain_en: Past simple active becomes past simple passive: was/were + past participle; the object becomes the subject.
questions.explain_bn: Past simple active-এর passive হয় was/were + past participle; object টি subject হয়।

questions.q_en: Choose the indirect speech: He said, 'I am ill.'
questions.q_bn: Indirect speech নির্ণয় করো: He said, 'I am ill.'
options_en: He said that he is ill.
He said that he was ill.
He says that he was ill.
He said that I was ill.
options_bn: He said that he is ill.
He said that he was ill.
He says that he was ill.
He said that I was ill.
questions.explain_en: When the reporting verb is in the past tense, present simple in direct speech changes to past simple in indirect speech.
questions.explain_bn: Reporting verb past tense হলে direct speech-এর present simple indirect speech-এ past simple হয়।

questions.q_en: Choose the indirect speech: She said to me, 'Do you know him?'
questions.q_bn: Indirect speech নির্ণয় করো: She said to me, 'Do you know him?'
options_en: She asked me that I knew him.
She asked me whether I know him.
She asked me if I knew him.
She told me do you know him.
options_bn: She asked me that I knew him.
She asked me whether I know him.
She asked me if I knew him.
She told me do you know him.
questions.explain_en: A yes/no question becomes 'asked + if/whether + subject + past verb' in indirect speech.
questions.explain_bn: Yes/no প্রশ্নের indirect speech হয় 'asked + if/whether + subject + past verb' গঠনে।

questions.q_en: Choose the indirect speech: The teacher said, 'The sun rises in the east.'
questions.q_bn: Indirect speech নির্ণয় করো: The teacher said, 'The sun rises in the east.'
options_en: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.
The teacher said that the sun rose in the east.
The teacher said that the sun has risen in the east.
The teacher says that the sun rises in the east.
options_bn: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.
The teacher said that the sun rose in the east.
The teacher said that the sun has risen in the east.
The teacher says that the sun rises in the east.
questions.explain_en: A universal truth does not change its tense in indirect speech.
questions.explain_bn: চিরন্তন সত্য (universal truth) indirect speech-এ tense পরিবর্তন হয় না।

questions.q_en: Choose the indirect speech: He said to me, 'Please help me.'
questions.q_bn: Indirect speech নির্ণয় করো: He said to me, 'Please help me.'
options_en: He told me that I help him.
He requested me that I helped him.
He said me please help me.
He requested me to help him.
options_bn: He told me that I help him.
He requested me that I helped him.
He said me please help me.
He requested me to help him.
questions.explain_en: A request in direct speech becomes 'requested + object + to + verb' in indirect speech.
questions.explain_bn: অনুরোধবাচক বাক্যের indirect speech হয় 'requested + object + to + verb' গঠনে।

questions.q_en: Choose the indirect speech: He said, 'I shall go tomorrow.'
questions.q_bn: Indirect speech নির্ণয় করো: He said, 'I shall go tomorrow.'
options_en: He said he will go tomorrow.
He said that he would go the next day.
He said that he should go tomorrow.
He says that he would go the next day.
options_bn: He said he will go tomorrow.
He said that he would go the next day.
He said that he should go tomorrow.
He says that he would go the next day.
questions.explain_en: 'Shall' becomes 'would' and 'tomorrow' becomes 'the next day' in indirect speech.
questions.explain_bn: Indirect speech-এ 'shall' → 'would' এবং 'tomorrow' → 'the next day' হয়।

questions.q_en: Choose the indirect speech: She said, 'I have finished my work.'
questions.q_bn: Indirect speech নির্ণয় করো: She said, 'I have finished my work.'
options_en: She said that she has finished her work.
She said that she had finished my work.
She said that she had finished her work.
She says that she had finished her work.
options_bn: She said that she has finished her work.
She said that she had finished my work.
She said that she had finished her work.
She says that she had finished her work.
questions.explain_en: Present perfect in direct speech changes to past perfect in indirect speech, and pronouns change accordingly.
questions.explain_bn: Direct speech-এর present perfect indirect speech-এ past perfect হয় এবং pronoun যথাযথভাবে বদলায়।

questions.q_en: Choose the indirect speech: The boy said, 'Hurrah! We have won.'
questions.q_bn: Indirect speech নির্ণয় করো: The boy said, 'Hurrah! We have won.'
options_en: The boy exclaimed with joy that they had won.
The boy said hurrah we won.
The boy exclaimed with joy that we have won.
The boy said that they have won with joy.
options_bn: The boy exclaimed with joy that they had won.
The boy said hurrah we won.
The boy exclaimed with joy that we have won.
The boy said that they have won with joy.
questions.explain_en: Exclamations of joy use 'exclaimed with joy that', and the present perfect changes to the past perfect.
questions.explain_bn: আনন্দসূচক উক্তিতে 'exclaimed with joy that' ব্যবহৃত হয় এবং present perfect past perfect হয়।

questions.q_en: Neither of the boys ___ present.
questions.q_bn: 'Neither of the boys ___ present.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Neither of' takes a singular verb; the past tense of 'be' for a singular subject is 'was'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Neither of'-এর পরে singular verb বসে; অতীতে singular subject-এর জন্য 'was' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: The quality of the mangoes ___ good.
questions.q_bn: 'The quality of the mangoes ___ good.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: The verb agrees with the main subject 'quality', which is singular, not with 'mangoes'.
questions.explain_bn: Verb মূল subject 'quality'-এর সাথে মিলবে, যা singular — 'mangoes'-এর সাথে নয়।

questions.q_en: Either Rahim or his friends ___ going.
questions.q_bn: 'Either Rahim or his friends ___ going.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: With 'either...or', the verb agrees with the nearer subject 'friends', which is plural.
questions.explain_bn: 'Either...or' গঠনে verb নিকটবর্তী subject 'friends'-এর সাথে মিলবে, যা plural।

questions.q_en: Two-thirds of the work ___ done.
questions.q_bn: 'Two-thirds of the work ___ done.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Work' is uncountable and singular, so the verb is singular: 'has been'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Work' অগণনীয় ও singular, তাই verb singular হবে: 'has been'।

questions.q_en: The committee ___ divided in its opinion.
questions.q_bn: 'The committee ___ divided in its opinion.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: When the members of a collective noun act separately (they are divided), the verb is plural.
questions.explain_bn: Collective noun-এর সদস্যরা আলাদা মত পোষণ করলে (divided) verb plural হয়।

questions.q_en: Each of the students ___ a pen.
questions.q_bn: 'Each of the students ___ a pen.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Each of' always takes a singular verb, so 'has' is correct.
questions.explain_bn: 'Each of'-এর পরে সবসময় singular verb বসে, তাই 'has' সঠিক।

questions.q_en: Fifty miles ___ a long distance.
questions.q_bn: 'Fifty miles ___ a long distance.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: A measurement expressing one single idea takes a singular verb.
questions.explain_bn: একটি একক ধারণা প্রকাশকারী পরিমাপের পরে singular verb বসে।

questions.q_en: He is afraid ___ dogs.
questions.q_bn: 'He is afraid ___ dogs.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন preposition বসবে?
questions.explain_en: The adjective 'afraid' is followed by the preposition 'of'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Afraid' adjective-টির পরে 'of' preposition বসে।

questions.q_en: She was born ___ 1998.
questions.q_bn: 'She was born ___ 1998.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন preposition বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'In' is used before years, months, and long periods of time.
questions.explain_bn: বছর, মাস বা দীর্ঘ সময়ের আগে 'in' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: The cat jumped ___ the table.
questions.q_bn: 'The cat jumped ___ the table.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন preposition বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Onto' shows movement to a surface, which fits jumping up to the table.
questions.explain_bn: কোনো পৃষ্ঠের দিকে গতি বোঝাতে 'onto' ব্যবহৃত হয়, যা টেবিলে লাফিয়ে ওঠার সাথে মানানসই।

questions.q_en: He has been ill ___ Monday.
questions.q_bn: 'He has been ill ___ Monday.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন preposition বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Since' is used with a point of time (Monday) in perfect tenses.
questions.explain_bn: Perfect tense-এ নির্দিষ্ট সময়বিন্দুর (Monday) আগে 'since' বসে।

questions.q_en: She is good ___ mathematics.
questions.q_bn: 'She is good ___ mathematics.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন preposition বসবে?
questions.explain_en: The adjective 'good' takes 'at' when it means skilled in something.
questions.explain_bn: দক্ষতা অর্থে 'good' adjective-টির পরে 'at' বসে।

questions.q_en: He died ___ cholera.
questions.q_bn: 'He died ___ cholera.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন preposition বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Die of' is used for a disease or illness.
questions.explain_bn: রোগে মারা যাওয়া বোঝাতে 'die of' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: Distribute the mangoes ___ the children.
questions.q_bn: 'Distribute the mangoes ___ the children.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন preposition বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Among' is used when distributing to more than two people or things.
questions.explain_bn: দুইয়ের অধিক ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর মধ্যে বণ্টনে 'among' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: I have no objection ___ your proposal.
questions.q_bn: 'I have no objection ___ your proposal.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন preposition বসবে?
questions.explain_en: The noun 'objection' is followed by the preposition 'to'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Objection' noun-টির পরে 'to' preposition বসে।

questions.q_en: ___ honest man is respected everywhere.
questions.q_bn: '___ honest man is respected everywhere.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন article বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound (the h is silent), so 'an' is used.
questions.explain_bn: 'Honest' শব্দটি vowel ধ্বনি দিয়ে শুরু (h অনুচ্চারিত), তাই 'an' বসে।

questions.q_en: He is ___ university student.
questions.q_bn: 'He is ___ university student.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন article বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'University' begins with the consonant sound /juː/, so 'a' is used.
questions.explain_bn: 'University' ব্যঞ্জনধ্বনি /juː/ দিয়ে শুরু, তাই 'a' বসে।

questions.q_en: ___ moon shines at night.
questions.q_bn: '___ moon shines at night.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন article বসবে?
questions.explain_en: Unique natural objects like the moon take the definite article 'the'.
questions.explain_bn: পৃথিবীতে একমাত্র এমন প্রাকৃতিক বস্তুর আগে 'the' বসে।

questions.q_en: He plays ___ cricket.
questions.q_bn: 'He plays ___ cricket.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন article বসবে?
questions.explain_en: No article is used before the names of games and sports.
questions.explain_bn: খেলাধুলার নামের আগে কোনো article বসে না।

questions.q_en: ___ Ganges is a sacred river.
questions.q_bn: '___ Ganges is a sacred river.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন article বসবে?
questions.explain_en: Rivers take the definite article 'the'.
questions.explain_bn: নদীর নামের আগে 'the' বসে।

questions.q_en: She went to ___ hospital to see her friend.
questions.q_bn: 'She went to ___ hospital to see her friend.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোন article বসবে?
questions.explain_en: A specific, known hospital takes the definite article 'the'.
questions.explain_bn: নির্দিষ্ট পরিচিত হাসপাতালের আগে 'the' বসে।

questions.q_en: If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.
questions.q_bn: 'If I ___ rich, I would travel the world.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: In the second conditional, 'were' is used with all subjects after 'if'.
questions.explain_bn: Second conditional-এ 'if'-এর পরে সব subject-এর সাথে 'were' ব্যবহৃত হয়।

questions.q_en: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.q_bn: 'If you heat ice, it ___.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: The zero conditional expresses a general truth and uses the simple present in both clauses.
questions.explain_bn: Zero conditional সাধারণ সত্য প্রকাশ করে এবং উভয় clause-এ simple present tense নেয়।

questions.q_en: If he had arrived earlier, he ___ the bus.
questions.q_bn: 'If he had arrived earlier, he ___ the bus.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: The third conditional uses if + past perfect, followed by would have + past participle.
questions.explain_bn: Third conditional-এ if + past perfect-এর পরে would have + past participle বসে।

questions.q_en: If it rains, we ___ at home.
questions.q_bn: 'If it rains, we ___ at home.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: The first conditional uses if + present simple, followed by will + base verb.
questions.explain_bn: First conditional-এ if + present simple-এর পরে will + মূল verb বসে।

questions.q_en: Had I known the truth, I ___ helped him.
questions.q_bn: 'Had I known the truth, I ___ helped him.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: 'Had I known' is an inverted third conditional, so the result clause uses 'would have'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Had I known' হলো inverted third conditional, তাই ফলাফল clause-এ 'would have' বসে।

questions.q_en: If she ___ harder, she would succeed.
questions.q_bn: 'If she ___ harder, she would succeed.' — শূন্যস্থানে কোনটি বসবে?
questions.explain_en: The second conditional uses if + past simple, followed by would + base verb.
questions.explain_bn: Second conditional-এ if + past simple-এর পরে would + মূল verb বসে।

questions.q_en: In 'He runs quickly', the word 'quickly' is a/an ___.
questions.q_bn: 'He runs quickly' বাক্যে 'quickly' শব্দটি কোন পদ?
questions.explain_en: 'Quickly' modifies the verb 'runs', so it is an adverb.
questions.explain_bn: 'Quickly' verb 'runs'-কে বিশেষিত করে, তাই এটি adverb।

questions.q_en: Which word is a preposition in 'The book is on the table'?
questions.q_bn: 'The book is on the table' বাক্যে কোনটি preposition?
questions.explain_en: 'On' shows the relation between 'book' and 'table', so it is a preposition.
questions.explain_bn: 'On' 'book' ও 'table'-এর সম্পর্ক দেখায়, তাই এটি preposition।

questions.q_en: 'Honesty' is a ___ noun.
questions.q_bn: 'Honesty' কোন ধরনের noun?
questions.explain_en: 'Honesty' names a quality that cannot be touched or seen, so it is an abstract noun.
questions.explain_bn: 'Honesty' একটি গুণবাচক নাম যা স্পর্শ বা দেখা যায় না, তাই এটি abstract noun।

questions.q_en: In 'They went home', the word 'they' is a ___ pronoun.
questions.q_bn: 'They went home' বাক্যে 'they' কোন ধরনের pronoun?
questions.explain_en: 'They' stands for persons and is used as the subject, so it is a personal pronoun.
questions.explain_bn: 'They' ব্যক্তিকে বোঝায় এবং subject হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাই এটি personal pronoun।

questions.q_en: The word 'beautiful' is a/an ___.
questions.q_bn: 'Beautiful' শব্দটি কোন পদ?
questions.explain_en: 'Beautiful' describes a noun, so it is an adjective.
questions.explain_bn: 'Beautiful' noun-কে বর্ণনা করে, তাই এটি adjective।

questions.q_en: In 'Alas! He is dead', the word 'alas' is a/an ___.
questions.q_bn: 'Alas! He is dead' বাক্যে 'alas' কোন পদ?
questions.explain_en: 'Alas' expresses a sudden emotion, so it is an interjection.
questions.explain_bn: 'Alas' হঠাৎ আবেগ প্রকাশ করে, তাই এটি interjection।

questions.q_en: In 'Running is good exercise', the word 'running' is a ___.
questions.q_bn: 'Running is good exercise' বাক্যে 'running' কী?
questions.explain_en: 'Running' is a verb form used as the subject (a noun), so it is a gerund.
questions.explain_bn: 'Running' subject (noun) হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত verb-রূপ, তাই এটি gerund।

questions.q_en: In 'He stayed home because he was ill', the word 'because' is a ___.
questions.q_bn: 'He stayed home because he was ill' বাক্যে 'because' কোন পদ?
questions.explain_en: 'Because' joins two clauses, so it is a subordinating conjunction.
questions.explain_bn: 'Because' দুটি clause-কে যুক্ত করে, তাই এটি conjunction।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'abandon'.
questions.q_bn: 'abandon'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Abandon' means to give up or leave behind; 'leave' is its synonym.
questions.explain_bn: 'Abandon' অর্থ ত্যাগ করা বা ছেড়ে দেওয়া; 'leave'-এর অর্থও ত্যাগ করা।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'brave'.
questions.q_bn: 'brave'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Brave' means showing no fear; 'courageous' has the same meaning.
questions.explain_bn: 'Brave' অর্থ নির্ভীক; 'courageous'-এর অর্থও সাহসী।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'rapid'.
questions.q_bn: 'rapid'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Rapid' means happening quickly; 'swift' means the same.
questions.explain_bn: 'Rapid' অর্থ দ্রুতগতির; 'swift'-এর অর্থও দ্রুত।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'honest'.
questions.q_bn: 'honest'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Honest' means truthful and sincere; 'truthful' is its synonym.
questions.explain_bn: 'Honest' অর্থ সৎ ও সত্যবাদী; 'truthful'-এর অর্থও সত্যবাদী।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'ancient'.
questions.q_bn: 'ancient'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Ancient' means very old; 'old' is its synonym.
questions.explain_bn: 'Ancient' অর্থ অতি পুরনো; 'old'-এর অর্থও পুরনো।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'generous'.
questions.q_bn: 'generous'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Generous' means giving freely; 'kind-hearted' expresses the same idea.
questions.explain_bn: 'Generous' অর্থ উদার; 'kind-hearted'-এর অর্থও দয়ালু/উদার।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'fragile'.
questions.q_bn: 'fragile'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Fragile' means easily broken; 'delicate' means the same.
questions.explain_bn: 'Fragile' অর্থ সহজে ভেঙে যায় এমন; 'delicate'-এর অর্থও ভঙ্গুর।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'victory'.
questions.q_bn: 'victory'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Victory' means success in a contest; 'triumph' is its synonym.
questions.explain_bn: 'Victory' অর্থ জয়লাভ; 'triumph'-এর অর্থও বিজয়।

questions.q_en: Choose the synonym of 'expand'.
questions.q_bn: 'expand'-এর সমার্থক শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Expand' means to become or make larger; 'enlarge' means the same.
questions.explain_bn: 'Expand' অর্থ প্রসারিত করা; 'enlarge'-এর অর্থও বড় করা।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'generous'.
questions.q_bn: 'generous'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Generous' means giving freely; its opposite is 'miserly' (unwilling to spend).
questions.explain_bn: 'Generous' অর্থ উদার; এর বিপরীত 'miserly' (কৃপণ)।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'expand'.
questions.q_bn: 'expand'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Expand' means to grow larger; its opposite is 'contract' (to shrink).
questions.explain_bn: 'Expand' অর্থ প্রসারিত হওয়া; এর বিপরীত 'contract' (সংকুচিত হওয়া)।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'victory'.
questions.q_bn: 'victory'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Victory' means winning; its opposite is 'defeat'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Victory' অর্থ বিজয়; এর বিপরীত 'defeat' (পরাজয়)।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'ancient'.
questions.q_bn: 'ancient'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Ancient' means very old; its opposite is 'modern'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Ancient' অর্থ অতি পুরনো; এর বিপরীত 'modern' (আধুনিক)।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'brave'.
questions.q_bn: 'brave'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Brave' means fearless; its opposite is 'cowardly'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Brave' অর্থ সাহসী; এর বিপরীত 'cowardly' (কাপুরুষ)।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'honest'.
questions.q_bn: 'honest'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Honest' means truthful; its opposite is 'dishonest'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Honest' অর্থ সৎ; এর বিপরীত 'dishonest' (অসৎ)।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'rapid'.
questions.q_bn: 'rapid'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Rapid' means fast; its opposite is 'slow'.
questions.explain_bn: 'Rapid' অর্থ দ্রুত; এর বিপরীত 'slow' (ধীর)।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'fragile'.
questions.q_bn: 'fragile'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Fragile' means easily broken; its opposite is 'sturdy' (strong and solid).
questions.explain_bn: 'Fragile' অর্থ ভঙ্গুর; এর বিপরীত 'sturdy' (মজবুত)।

questions.q_en: Choose the antonym of 'lucid'.
questions.q_bn: 'lucid'-এর বিপরীত শব্দ কোনটি?
questions.explain_en: 'Lucid' means clear and easy to understand; its opposite is 'obscure' (unclear).
questions.explain_bn: 'Lucid' অর্থ স্পষ্ট ও সহজবোধ্য; এর বিপরীত 'obscure' (অস্পষ্ট)।

questions.q_en: The meaning of 'to bite the dust' is —
questions.q_bn: 'to bite the dust' বাগধারাটির অর্থ কী?
options_bn: to fail or be defeated (ব্যর্থ বা পরাজিত হওয়া)
questions.explain_en: 'To bite the dust' means to fail or be defeated, originally describing a fallen rider.
questions.explain_bn: 'To bite the dust' অর্থ ব্যর্থ হওয়া বা পরাজিত হওয়া।

questions.q_en: The meaning of 'a blessing in disguise' is —
questions.q_bn: 'a blessing in disguise' বাগধারাটির অর্থ কী?
questions.explain_en: 'A blessing in disguise' is something that seems bad at first but turns out to be good — a hidden benefit.
questions.explain_bn: 'A blessing in disguise' হলো এমন কিছু যা প্রথমে খারাপ মনে হলেও পরে কল্যাণকর প্রমাণিত হয় — লুকানো কল্যাণ।

questions.q_en: The meaning of 'to cry over spilt milk' is —
questions.q_bn: 'to cry over spilt milk' বাগধারাটির অর্থ কী?
options_en: to regret what cannot be changed
options_bn: to be very thirsty (খুব তৃষ্ণার্ত হওয়া)
to clean up a mess (অগোছালো পরিষ্কার করা)
to regret what cannot be changed (যা বদলানো যায় না তা নিয়ে আফসোস করা)
questions.explain_en: 'To cry over spilt milk' means to waste time regretting something that cannot be undone.
questions.explain_bn: 'To cry over spilt milk' অর্থ যা আর বদলানো যায় না তা নিয়ে বৃথা আফসোস করা।

questions.q_en: The meaning of 'to break the ice' is —
questions.q_bn: 'to break the ice' বাগধারাটির অর্থ কী?
options_bn: to start a conversation (কথোপকথন শুরু করা)
to end a friendship (বন্ধুত্ব শেষ করা)
questions.explain_en: 'To break the ice' means to do or say something to start a conversation and ease tension.
questions.explain_bn: 'To break the ice' অর্থ কথোপকথন শুরু করে জড়তা কাটানো।

questions.q_en: The meaning of 'once in a blue moon' is —
questions.q_bn: 'once in a blue moon' বাগধারাটির অর্থ কী?
questions.explain_en: 'Once in a blue moon' describes something that happens very rarely.
questions.explain_bn: 'Once in a blue moon' অর্থ খুব কদাচিৎ ঘটে এমন কিছু।

questions.q_en: The meaning of 'to hit the nail on the head' is —
questions.q_bn: 'to hit the nail on the head' বাগধারাটির অর্থ কী?
options_en: to say exactly the right thing
options_bn: to work with tools (যন্ত্রপাতি দিয়ে কাজ করা)
to say exactly the right thing (একদম সঠিক কথা বলা)
to miss the point (মূল বিষয় মিস করা)
questions.explain_en: 'To hit the nail on the head' means to say or do exactly the right thing.
questions.explain_bn: 'To hit the nail on the head' অর্থ একদম সঠিক কথা বলা বা কাজ করা।

questions.q_en: The meaning of 'a piece of cake' is —
questions.q_bn: 'a piece of cake' বাগধারাটির অর্থ কী?
questions.explain_en: 'A piece of cake' means something very easy to do.
questions.explain_bn: 'A piece of cake' অর্থ খুব সহজ কাজ।

questions.q_en: The meaning of 'to burn the midnight oil' is —
questions.q_bn: 'to burn the midnight oil' বাগধারাটির অর্থ কী?
options_en: to study or work late at night
options_bn: to study or work late at night (গভীর রাত পর্যন্ত পড়া বা কাজ করা)
to cook at night (রাতে রান্না করা)
questions.explain_en: 'To burn the midnight oil' means to study or work late into the night.
questions.explain_bn: 'To burn the midnight oil' অর্থ গভীর রাত পর্যন্ত পড়াশোনা বা কাজ করা।

questions.q_en: One who can use both hands equally well is called —
questions.q_bn: যে ব্যক্তি উভয় হাত সমান দক্ষতায় ব্যবহার করতে পারে তাকে কী বলে?
questions.explain_en: 'Ambidextrous' (ambi = both, dextrous = skilled) means able to use both hands equally well.
questions.explain_bn: 'Ambidextrous' (ambi = উভয়, dextrous = দক্ষ) অর্থ উভয় হাত সমানভাবে ব্যবহারে সক্ষম।

questions.q_en: A person who speaks many languages is called —
questions.q_bn: যে ব্যক্তি অনেক ভাষায় কথা বলতে পারে তাকে কী বলে?
questions.explain_en: A 'polyglot' is a person who knows or uses several languages.
questions.explain_bn: 'Polyglot' হলো এমন ব্যক্তি যে একাধিক ভাষা জানে বা ব্যবহার করে।

questions.q_en: One who hates mankind is called —
questions.q_bn: যে মানবজাতিকে ঘৃণা করে তাকে কী বলে?
questions.explain_en: A 'misanthrope' is a person who dislikes or distrusts humankind.
questions.explain_bn: 'Misanthrope' হলো মানবজাতিকে অপছন্দকারী ব্যক্তি।

questions.q_en: A place where birds are kept is called —
questions.q_bn: যেখানে পাখি রাখা হয় সেই জায়গাকে কী বলে?
questions.explain_en: An 'aviary' is a large enclosure for keeping birds.
questions.explain_bn: 'Aviary' হলো পাখি রাখার বড় খাঁচা বা পক্ষিশালা।

questions.q_en: One who is new to a profession is called —
questions.q_bn: যে পেশায় নতুন তাকে কী বলে?
questions.explain_en: A 'novice' is a person new to a field or activity.
questions.explain_bn: 'Novice' হলো কোনো ক্ষেত্রে নতুন ব্যক্তি।

questions.q_en: Government by the people is called —
questions.q_bn: জনগণের শাসনকে কী বলে?
questions.explain_en: 'Democracy' is government by the people, through elected representatives.
questions.explain_bn: 'Democracy' হলো জনগণের শাসন, নির্বাচিত প্রতিনিধিদের মাধ্যমে।

questions.q_en: A person who writes dictionaries is called —
questions.q_bn: যে ব্যক্তি অভিধান রচনা করে তাকে কী বলে?
questions.explain_en: A 'lexicographer' is a person who compiles dictionaries.
questions.explain_bn: 'Lexicographer' হলো অভিধান সংকলনকারী ব্যক্তি।

questions.q_en: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.q_bn: সঠিক বানানযুক্ত শব্দটি বেছে নাও।
questions.explain_en: The correct spelling is 'occasion' — double 'c', single 's'.
questions.explain_bn: সঠিক বানান 'occasion' — double 'c', single 's'।

questions.q_en: Which of these words is spelt correctly?
questions.q_bn: কোন শব্দটির বানান সঠিক?
questions.explain_en: The correct spelling is 'embarrass' — double 'r', double 's'.
questions.explain_bn: সঠিক বানান 'embarrass' — double 'r', double 's'।

questions.q_en: Select the word with the correct spelling.
questions.q_bn: সঠিক বানানযুক্ত শব্দটি নির্বাচন করো।
questions.explain_en: The correct spelling is 'separate' — remember 'a rat' in the middle: sep-a-rat-e.
questions.explain_bn: সঠিক বানান 'separate' — মাঝে 'a rat' মনে রাখো: sep-a-rat-e।

questions.q_en: Identify the correctly spelt word.
questions.q_bn: সঠিক বানানযুক্ত শব্দটি চিহ্নিত করো।
questions.explain_en: The correct spelling is 'necessary' — one 'c', double 's'.
questions.explain_bn: সঠিক বানান 'necessary' — একটি 'c', double 's'।

questions.q_en: Pick the word that is spelt correctly.
questions.q_bn: সঠিক বানানযুক্ত শব্দটি বাছাই করো।
questions.explain_en: The correct spelling is 'accommodate' — double 'c', double 'm'.
questions.explain_bn: সঠিক বানান 'accommodate' — double 'c', double 'm'।

questions.q_en: Book : Pages :: Wall : ?
questions.q_bn: বই : পৃষ্ঠা :: দেয়াল : ?
questions.explain_en: A book is made up of pages, just as a wall is made up of bricks (part-to-whole relation).
questions.explain_bn: বই যেমন পৃষ্ঠা দিয়ে তৈরি, দেয়াল তেমনি ইট দিয়ে তৈরি (অংশ-সমগ্র সম্পর্ক)।

questions.q_en: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.q_bn: ডাক্তার : হাসপাতাল :: শিক্ষক : ?
questions.explain_en: A doctor works in a hospital, just as a teacher works in a school (worker-to-workplace relation).
questions.explain_bn: ডাক্তার যেমন হাসপাতালে কাজ করে, শিক্ষক তেমনি বিদ্যালয়ে কাজ করে (কর্মী-কর্মস্থল সম্পর্ক)।

questions.q_en: Bird : Nest :: Bee : ?
questions.explain_en: A bird lives in a nest, just as a bee lives in a hive (dweller-to-dwelling relation).
questions.explain_bn: পাখি যেমন বাসায় থাকে, মৌমাছি তেমনি মৌচাকে থাকে (বাসিন্দা-বাসস্থান সম্পর্ক)।

questions.q_en: Hot : Cold :: Day : ?
questions.q_bn: গরম : ঠান্ডা :: দিন : ?
questions.explain_en: Hot and cold are opposites, just as day and night are opposites.
questions.explain_bn: গরম ও ঠান্ডা যেমন বিপরীত, দিন ও রাতও তেমনি বিপরীত।

questions.q_en: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.q_bn: কলম : লেখা :: ছুরি : ?
questions.explain_en: A pen is used to write, just as a knife is used to cut (tool-to-function relation).
questions.explain_bn: কলম যেমন লেখার কাজে ব্যবহৃত হয়, ছুরি তেমনি কাটার কাজে ব্যবহৃত হয় (যন্ত্র-কার্য সম্পর্ক)।
